ftbquests.description: Exact target, closed schemas, client-only scope and submission workflow. No game reads.

ftbquests.book.description: Visible-only overall/group/chapter statistics, session, version and pending receipt. Never open GUI.

limit.description: Default 8. Results bounded by limit and 1 MiB row JSON budget; cursor binds identical filters/limit/session/version.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token, expires in 30s. Keep query fields unchanged. Drift is stale_cursor, never an empty complete page.

query.description: Case-insensitive search in visible returned title/subtitle/description/task/reward preview text.

ftbquests.claimable.description: Unfiltered native all_not_excluded preview with all completed unclaimed visible reward rows, exclusions and side-effect classification. Walk every page for preview_token.

request_id.description: Exact operation UUID. Reads current synced claimed state when available and returns retained receipt even when disconnected; never resubmits.

session.description: Fresh observation token, 30 second TTL; bound to world/player/connection/file/selfTeamData and full content/progress snapshot.

request_id.description: One UUID per operation; match core action_id. Dry-run is a separate operation UUID from the real submit because core action IDs bind the full payload. Retained receipts never auto-expire/re-send; ambiguous delivery blocks new mutations until claimed read-back, including after context change.

dry_run.description: Default true. false explicitly submits exactly once.

reward_id.description: Reward ID from visible quest rewards, exactly 16 lower-case hexadecimal digits; JSON number IDs forbidden.

expected_reward_hash.description: Same snapshot reward_hash; binds definition, eligibility and choice/table content.

ftbquests.reward.claim.description: One native ClaimRewardMessage(id,true) for audited ordinary reward routes. Choice requires reward.choose. No setters or direct Reward.claim calls.

choice_index.description: Explicit zero-based ordered table index from choice_candidates, never defaulted.

expected_table_hash.description: Whole recursive table identity, all candidates/weights/definitions; parent must be completed and unclaimed.

ftbquests.reward.choose.description: One ClaimChoiceRewardMessage. Native server calls child.claim before marking parent, so adapter requires parent unclaimed, unlocked/unblocked self-team and a fully reviewed bounded table. No automatic first choice.

preview_token.description: Issued only by the final page of a complete unfiltered ftbquests.claimable preview; session/hash/count bound, 30s expiry.

scope.description: Native global scope. No chapter/type filter exists.

expected_claimable_hash.description: Exact claimable_hash from completed preview, including exclusions, definitions and effects.

expected_claimable_count.description: Exact eligible, unclaimed, unblocked native candidate count.

max_rewards.description: Explicit count budget; native packet has no server-side budget/filter. Races remain possible.

ftbquests.rewards.claim_all.description: One native ClaimAllRewardsMessage(), never a per-reward loop. Fails closed if native scope includes hidden, unknown or unsafe-choice candidates. Built-in ChoiceReward is excluded by native getExcludeFromClaimAll(). Preconfigured command/custom/table effects remain native.

dry_run.description: Default true. false explicitly submits exactly once.

task_id.description: Exact visible, startable checkmark task. No resource tasks or progress setters.

acknowledge_read.description: Must explicitly be true: caller has read this informational task. Does not authorize task editing or resource submission.

limitations: Client sync can lag server; submitted and claimed read-back do not prove inventory delivery or command effects.
Native claim_all has global scope and no expected-hash/count fields on the wire. Client preflight cannot eliminate server races.
Configured command/custom/advancement/stage/table rewards may change server state. Native effects are neither edited nor elevated by this plugin.
Only explicit acknowledged checkmark confirmation; no resource task submission, editor, reset, give/creative, arbitrary commands, server files or other-team data.
No GUI operation or command-link click. Unknown/unsynced data is explicit and cannot authorize a mutation.
Complete every preview page. New UUID is not a retry strategy for unknown delivery. Receipts are in-memory for this provider lifetime.
